At least 3 Insignias of Aban plus an Ancient Device from Donna Red; tag 3 Dreaming Silvertails.
At least 3 insignias plus an Ancient Device from Veronica Escobar; 3 Dreaming Silvertails. Nascence has no sanctuary quests.

Level 25 or under. Abmouth Supremus. Part of the RK2019-only Serpentine set — armor self-levels to 220.

Levels 40–60. Aztur the Immortal One. (The Azzy kill is the Sleeves, not the Boots.)
Levels 41–100. Neutrals may take either path, but start with Ace Starr (Clan) or Dr. Hercules Lincoln (Omni) to get the Collar of Amplification. 125k XP.
Level 50+. T.I.M. (The TIM kill is the Boots, not the Legs.)
Levels 50–100. Tag 9 Unredeemed mobs — 3 Remnans, 4 Stormshelter, 2 Nero.
Levels 50–100. Kill 9 named Unredeemed (all level 70), loot the Briefing.
Levels 50–100. Collect up to 8 Shere insignias first, then tag Redeemed mobs with the Ancient Tracking Device.
Levels 50–100. Needs the Shere garden key first, then 9 sequential elimination missions.
Progression. 4 body parts, then beat the Challenger. Opens Scheol.
Levels 60–150. Three paths; the middle one gives the Eye of the Evening Star plus 100k XP and 250k credits.

n: One Who Has Taken Vow of Truth
d: Levels 60–150. Up to 5 missions. One-time only. Sample reward: Wrath of Zeus, 380k XP, 1m credits.
Levels 60–200. First mission gives a Ring of Computing. The catacomb path is 7 bosses, each worth roughly a daily.

n: The One Loved by the Sun
d: Levels 60–150. Diving for Pearls gives Silver Spider Knuckle Dusters, 200k XP, 250k credits.
Levels 60–150. Note: the guide says final completion yields no credits or XP.
Levels 60–150. Gives Spec 2 chapter 3, 20k XP, 50k credits.

Levels 80–220. Requires the Jobe Scientists line first. Beo's tip: pull it at 199 and run it at 201–203.
All levels, but you need level 95 to spawn the Empath. 4 blueprint pieces plus a Crystal Filled by the Source. Needs 337 Nano Programming and 135 Quantum FT.

All levels, but you need level 95 to spawn the boss. 4 blueprint pieces of Weary Empath Min-Ji Liu, a Crystal Filled by the Source and a Subdued Flow of Novictum.
Needs the Roch garden key first. You must do the majority of damage to the Empath for loot rights.
Progression, levels 1–129. Opens Adonis. At 130+ you can skip it — Ergo hands over the ring and scuba gear.

z: Milky Way, near Holes in the Wall
d: Level 120+. This is where the Prototype Cyborg Token Board comes from. 1,050,000 XP and credits.
Levels 60–220; 80+ past the first stage, 120+ for Cyborg Valley. Rewards profession nano crystals — no neck item.
Level 125+. Hezak the Immortal One.

z: Mantis and Smuggler's Den, S. Foul Hills
d: Level 130+. Mantis Queen.
Level 150+. Ian Warr.

Levels 150–200. Note drops 100% from Hypnagogic Jorr-Thrak Dal or Fortuitous Urga-Yutt Dal, then 2 Ancient Control Panels.

Levels 150–200. You must have done the solo version first. 7,000,000 XP regardless of your level.

Levels 160–220. This is where you need the 6 insignias of Cama, traded to Ardent Gulu Van to spawn the final bosses.
Levels 150–220. Team needed for the final Alappaa instance. Profession nano crystal from Anticipating Six. The Specializations guide lists this as a Spec 4 source.
Gets the sided Ice Golem Molar needed for Inferno.
Gets the sided Ice Golem Molar needed for Inferno.

Zone gates: Scheol needs level 80 or the ring quest, Adonis 130 plus 5,001 Guardian, Penumbra 160 plus the radiation protection, Inferno needs the Ice Golem Molar and Inferno Boots plus 18,001 Guardian.
